newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil airline Transbrasil expands flight routes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil airline Transbrasil expands flight routes.

text.p: Brazilian airline Transbrasil is launching new flights to Florida, Europe and Argentina, the company said in a statement.
The company has added four flights a week from Rio de Janeiro via Brasilia to Miami and Orlando to its existing daily flights from Sao Paulo to Miami and Orlando.
The new flights will leave Rio de Janeiro Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays, Transbrasil said.
The airline is also launching a new route to Europe November 24, with four flights a week from Rio de Janeiro to London. Transbrasil already operates flights to Vienna and Amsterdam.
And in December, Transbrasil's flight from the southern Brazilian city of Curitiba to the Foz do Iguacu falls will be extended to continue on to Cordoba in Argentina.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
